question: Can already-authenticated B512/S615 records be joined on identical exact canonical states to compare raw policy choice, recorded search choice, exact action margins, and paired recorded game outcomes?

registered_search_records.admissibility: exclude unless an authenticated freeze independently binds both checkpoint identities, matching exact canonical roots, recorded decisions, search settings, and seed identities

matching_rules.primary_key: exact canonical state identity including player-to-move perspective, as recorded by the authenticated evidence producers
matching_rules.trajectory_reconstruction: replay only the recorded Seed 615 move sequence from its authenticated opening state; do not run model inference, search, solving, or tablebase probes
matching_rules.policy_join: exact identity equality only; no approximate float comparison
matching_rules.search_action_join: only the action actually present at the matched decision in the authenticated game trajectory; never infer it from a prior, visits absent from the record, or a regenerated search
matching_rules.opening_group: use only authenticated Seed 615 opening identifiers; do not crosswalk source-opening labels to Seed 624 identifiers
matching_rules.duplicates: retain repeated occurrences in occurrence-level evidence; summarize unique canonical states separately; do not treat repeats as independent positions
matching_rules.perspective: match and score margins from the root player-to-move perspective; reject a mismatch rather than normalize by guess

requirements: all required values are present on identical exact canonical states
both candidate-specific trajectory occurrences are authenticated and match their registered checkpoint
the exact-optimal action set can be reconstructed including ties
the search configuration and distinct candidate-specific seeds are authenticated
adequacy is evaluated from coverage only, before any action-quality or outcome differences are computed
go_no_go_criteria.decision: If any criterion fails, publish coverage and stop without computing decision-quality contrasts or mechanism diagnostics.

mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.effect_scale: mean paired difference in exact regret points; report cluster-bootstrap stability interval
mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.equalization: both searched model regrets have absolute mean <= 1 point and the absolute B512/S615 searched-regret difference is <= 1 point, while raw regret difference is >= 2 points
mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.preservation: searched regret difference has the same sign as raw regret difference, absolute magnitude at least 1 point, and searched/raw magnitude ratio in [0.5, 1.5]
mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.amplification: searched regret difference has the same sign as raw regret difference and magnitude at least 2 times the raw regret difference, with searched absolute difference >= 1 point
mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.mixed: none of the above and cluster stability interval spans both practically meaningful directions (-1,+1) or subgroup directions robustly differ
mechanism_thresholds_if_gate_passes.justification: One outcome point is a conservative minimum practically interpretable change on the exact score-margin scale; thresholds avoid assigning a mechanism to statistically non-robust or negligible movement.

outcome_analysis: Only if the gate passes and exact trajectory correspondence exists; first-divergence-selected states remain a separate selected cohort, opening-clustered descriptive association only, not causal inference.
prohibitions: no training, model inference, MCTS, games, solving, or tablebase probes
no checkpoint or search configuration changes
no candidate promotion or execution authorization
no inferred search action from a policy prior
no independent-population, causal, or general playing-strength claim
